_comment: ANC test configuration. Keys prefixed with '_comment' are documentation only and ignored at runtime.

anc._comment_description: Human-readable label for this suite; shown in logs/reports.
anc._comment_inactivity_timeout: Per-group INACTIVITY timeout in seconds (900 = 15 min). A group is aborted only after this many seconds with NO new ANC output; a group that keeps printing progress runs as long as it needs (no total wall-clock cap). Raise this only if a legitimate ANC item can stay silent longer than the default between output lines.
anc._comment_install_timeout: Package download+install INACTIVITY timeout in seconds (1800 = 30 min), used only by anc_installation / the install pre-task. It is a per-read (no-output) timeout, not a total budget: the download prints a periodic progress heartbeat so a slow link never trips it, while a genuine stall still fails. Raise this only if download+extract of the large content package legitimately needs longer between output lines.
anc._comment_anc_version: OPTIONAL minimum ANC version. Leave blank to run against whatever version is installed. When set, a node below it is upgraded ONLY if anc_release_url can satisfy it (its version >= anc_version); the installer then runs on all nodes and post-verifies each one. When the version cannot be satisfied (URL too old, or blank), the install suite (anc_installation) FAILS, while normal group/item tests log the shortfall and proceed with the installed version. Validated (must be a dotted release like 1.7.0) only when it is compared. Each node's packaging generation is auto-detected from its own output. A release candidate is treated as its base release (1.7.0-rc.1 as 1.7.0); the rc number is never compared.
anc._comment_anc_release_url: OPTIONAL. URL of the ANC release archive, used only when ANC must be downloaded/installed (a node has no ANC, or has an older version than anc_version and must be upgraded). Leave it blank to run against whatever ANC is already installed on the nodes; normal group/item tests then proceed with the installed version. The URL is validated only when it is actually used to install: packaging generation is auto-detected from the filename (LEGACY <=1.4.x outer tarballs carry a '-deb-'/'-rpm-'/'-tar-' token, e.g. anc-release-helios-nda-1.4.9-tar-linux-x64.tar.gz; DIRECT 1.5.0+ URLs point straight at a '.deb'/'.rpm'/'.tar.gz' with no flavour token, e.g. anc-release-helios-nda-1.5.5-x86_64.tar.gz). When ANC must be installed but no node has ANC and this URL is blank, the test fails. The install suite (anc_installation) additionally fails if this URL's version is older than anc_version.
anc._comment_ANC_INSTALL_PATH: TAR installs ONLY: relocatable install prefix ANC is extracted into (its anc/ dir, tool folders, and content live under here). A leading '{home}' expands to the runner user's home directory (e.g. '/home/{user-id}/my/anc/install/path'); a leading '~' is also expanded. Applies exclusively to tar releases -- deb/rpm packages carry predefined absolute locations baked into their archive and IGNORE this key entirely. Leave blank or omit to keep the legacy default (/opt/amdtools).
anc._comment_print_all_to_console: 'True' echoes ANC group output to the console; 'False' suppresses it (install/ldconfig/version diagnostics still print).
anc._comment_ADD_ANC_LOGS_TO_HTML_REPORTS: 'True' always bundles the collected ANC log tree into the pytest-html report zip. 'False' (default) bundles it only when the test fails, so passing runs stay lean while failures always carry their logs.
